facts.text: Do not rush. The Everlasting Gobstopper never runs out, although you might. Mind the fizzy bubbles, and do not burp.
facts.why: Wikipedia says Charlie and Grandpa Joe get down from the ceiling fan by burping, so telling guests not to burp runs against the scene. The Gobstopper line is fine.
facts.fix: Do not rush. The Everlasting Gobstopper never runs out, although you might. Mind the fizzy bubbles, and burp if you must.
